SELECT x.* FROM dev_sample s JOIN LATERAL( SELECT o.* FROM dev_sample_order o WHERE o.tenant_key=s.tenant_key AND o.company_id=s.company_id AND o.sample_id=s.id ORDER BY o.sample_version DESC LIMIT 1 ) x ON true WHERE s.tenant_key=#{tenant} AND s.company_id=#{companyId} AND s.deleted_token=0
AND s.id IN #{id} AND false ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 101

SELECT o.* FROM dev_sample_order o JOIN dev_sample s ON s.tenant_key=o.tenant_key AND s.company_id=o.company_id AND s.id=o.sample_id AND s.deleted_token=0 JOIN LATERAL(SELECT maker_id FROM dev_sample_order x WHERE x.tenant_key=s.tenant_key AND x.company_id=s.company_id AND x.sample_id=s.id ORDER BY sample_version DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true WHERE o.tenant_key=#{tenant} AND o.company_id=#{companyId}
AND o.id IN #{id} AND false AND (s.create_by=#{scope.userId} OR s.designer_id=#{scope.userId} OR latest.maker_id=#{scope.userId}) ORDER BY o.sample_id,o.sample_version DESC LIMIT 101
